scope: Freeze future recipe and run engineering smoke only; no full training in this task
paper_vs_choice: Paper establishes 8/2 subject split and AMASS initialization. Our 30-epoch cap, seed, internal development split, and selection rule are explicit reproduction choices, not recovered author fine-tuning details.

checkpoint.known_difference: Initialization trained with 25 masks including five-sensor global; 24-mask fine-tuning does not undo that exposure

data.smoothing: Inherited centered five-frame acceleration mean only; do not re-smooth
data.orientation: Inherited elementwise resampling; no new orientation filter
data.batch_padding: zero pad inputs and 6D targets to the batch maximum; pass valid lengths to packed LSTM

mask_expansion: All 24 masks per motion window, after subject split; exclude global

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.initial_state: Fresh Adam; never inherit AMASS optimizer moments

loss.joint: MSE over SMPL FK positions in meters, all 24 joints
loss.padding: Include padding exactly as inherited public training loss; differs from padding-excluded reporting metrics
loss.body: Mean male shape, zero translation, pose blend shapes disabled

development.checkpoint_selection: Smallest full-development combined validation loss; exact ties choose earlier completed epoch. Never use training loss or test metrics to select.
development.validation_loss_reduction: Sum each batch mean times its padded B*T, divide by total padded B*T; do not average unequal batches equally
development.checkpoints: Keep last and best with optimizer, RNG, epoch/step, sampler generator/cursor, protocol hash; save after every completed epoch

final_first_eight.initialization: Reset to the same Epoch59 and fresh optimizer/seed, not the development fine-tuned weights
final_first_eight.epochs: K = number of completed development epochs at selected checkpoint, 1..30; fixed before final training
final_first_eight.checkpoint_selection: The checkpoint after exactly K epochs; no test-driven early stopping or selection
final_first_eight.reservation_role_change: s07/s08 enter training only in this separately labeled final stage and no longer form independent validation for that model

reporting.before_after: Same frozen checkpoint-independent pipeline and same sequences/masks for both models
reporting.inference: rolling last-frame, window125, stride1, prefix startup; no hidden-state carry
reporting.filter: Retain inherited centered acceleration filter and disclose up to 80ms lookahead plus upstream interpolation/filling; trailing is separate sensitivity analysis
reporting.shape_alignment: Same mean male SMPL, all24 joints/all6890 vertices, pelvis translation only for spatial errors; zero trajectory translation
reporting.aggregation: Within each mask frame-weight spatial errors and T-3-weight jitter over recordings; arithmetic mean across 24 masks. Also retain per-recording and per-mask results.
reporting.refinement: Raw network before/after; IMU-only IK is a separate future pipeline component
reporting.success: Engineering checks and all four metrics with known differences; low training loss is not paper reproduction success

smoke.coverage: Exactly one sample for each mask; varied training windows, including a short tail
smoke.validation_use: Loader sanity only; no checkpoint selection or tuning in smoke
smoke.resume_probe: Same prescribed next batch and RNG; compare uninterrupted/reloaded parameter and optimizer states

changes: Never silently alter this protocol in place. New recipe changes require a new protocol ID and run directory.
